description: Fixed ranking benchmark. The 2026-11-15 v1 set was not discriminative: every engine's top hit was on-topic, so weighting could barely move nDCG. This set is contested on purpose — each query pairs two results with near-identical token coverage of the query, so relevance cannot separate them and only engine trust or publication date can. Judgements are graded (2 = answers the query, 1 = related, 0 = off-topic) and recorded per canonical URL. Title token sets are kept below 0.6 Jaccard so entity resolution does not merge the pair into one source.
